item.title: Notify NYC - Police Activity - 5th Avenue and East 84th Street (MN)
item.description:
Notification issued 10-26-2026 at 12:26 PM.
Due to police activity, expect traffic delays and a heavy presence of emergency personnel in the area of 5th Avenue and East 84th Street in Manhattan. Use alternate routes to avoid the area and allow for additional travel time.
item.author: NYCEM [English]
